objects.name: Analytic 2137
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process performing sequential reads across multiple ICS configuration or data paths by a UID outside approved backup, engineering, or vendor-application accounts. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): sequential reads across ICS data paths by uid not in authorized data access UIDs, followed by tar/zip invocation within a short window
